scope: Proposition 17.3 (A fixed-reservoir collision bound) of the manuscript “Conditional information under deterministic coordinate sweeps” (preprints/Conditional-information-under-deterministic-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ad4125b0a60530a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 75-76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Let h ≥ n/8 and observe the paths of a fixed set of n − h cards through B = 5d physical shuffles, starting from arbitrary deterministic positions. Let K be the resulting conditional transition matrix on the available positions, and put Q = E[KKT]. For all sufficiently large d, every pair i, j of initial available positions satisfies Q(i, j) = E X x K(i, x)K(j, x) ≥ 1 − n−1/100 h , (17.2) 75 where the sum is over the terminal available positions and the expectation is over the observed paths. Consequently, for every real row vector z on the initial available positions with sum zero, E∥zK∥2 2 ≤ n−1/100 ∥z∥2 2 (17.3) for all sufficiently large d, uniformly over the observed set and its initial placement. The vector norms are Euclidean.
